घ: घ The fourth consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding to Gh.

घ m. (-घः) 1 A bell. 2 A rattling or gurgling sound. f. (घा) 1 A tinkling ornament worn by women round the waist. 2 Striking, killing. 3 Wetting, sprinkling. E. हन to kill, affix ड, and घ substituted for the radical letter, or the same affix, with घृ to sprinkle, &c.
घग्घ: घग्घ r. 1st cl. (घग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride; also घघ and गग्घ.
घघ: घघ r. 1st cl. (घघति) To laugh or to laugh at: see the preceding.
घट: घट r. 1st cl. (घटते) To act, to strive or endeavour. r. 10th cl. (घाटयति) 1 To unite or to put together. 2 To injure or kill. 3 To shine. (इ) घटि, r. 10th cl. (घण्टयति) To shine.

घट m. (-टः) 1 A large earthen water jar. 2 The sign Aquarius. 3 A measure: see कुम्भ. 4 An elephant's frontal sinus. 5 Suspending the breath as a religious exercise. 6 A man who makes effort or exertion. f. (-टा) 1 A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes. 2 Effort, endeavour. 3 An assembly. 4 A number, a collection, an assemblage. f. (-टी) 1 The Gharī or Indian clock, a plate of iron or mixed metal on which the hours are struck. 2 A small water jar, a ewer. E. घट to endeavour, &c. affixes अच् or अङ्, and fem. affix टाप् or ङीप्.
घटक: घटक m. (-कः) 1 A tree that produces fruit without apparent flowers. 2 A match-maker, an agent who ascertains or invents genealogies, and negociates matrimonial alliances. 3 A genealogist. E. घट to endeavour, and वुन् aff.
घटग्रह: घटग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a water pot. E. घट, and ग्रह to take, अच् aff.
घटदासी: घटदासी f. (-सी) A bawd or procuress. E. घट effort, and दासी a slave or servant.
घटन: घटन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Effort, exertion. 2 Assembling, bringing together. 3 Joining, mixing. 4 Occurring. E. घट to strive, &c. affix युच्.
घटयोनि: घटयोनि m. (-निः) The saint AGASTYA. घट a water jar, and योनि place of birth; the saint being born from a water jar: see कुम्भसम्भव.
घटराज: घटराज m. (-जः) A large water jar of baked clay. E. घट a jar, and राज king, chief.
घटस्थापन: घटस्थापन n. (-नं) Placing a water pot as a type of DURGĀ, an essential part of various Tāntrika ceremonies. E. घट, and स्थापन placing.
घटाटोप: घटाटोप m. (-पः) A covering for a carriage or any article of furniture. E. घट, and आटोप pride.
घटिक: घटिक n. (-कं) The posteriors. f. (-का) 1 The ancle; also घुटिका. 2 A Muhūrta or thirtieth part of a day and night. 3 A Daṇḍa or period of twenty-four minutes. m. (-कः) A waterman. E. घटी a clock, &c. affixes कन् and टाप् for the feminine; otherwise घट a jar, and ठन् aff.
घटित: घटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Devised, attempted. 2 Made of. 3 In contact with, contiguous, joined. E. घट to make effort, क्त aff.
घटिन्धम: घटिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Who blows or sounds in a jar. m. (-मः) A potter. E. घटी, and ध्मा to blow, खश् aff.
घटिन्धय: घटिन्धय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who drinks a Ghaṭī, (in measure.) E. घटी, and धे to drink, खश् aff.
घटीकार: घटीकार m. (-रः) A potter. E. घट, कार who makes, with च्चि aff.
घटीग्रह: घटीग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who or what takes a small jar, &c. E. घटी, and ग्रह who takes.
घटीयन्त्र: घटीयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) The rope and bucket of a well, or any machine for raising water. E. घट effort, and यन्त्र machine.
घटोत्कच: घटोत्कच m. (-चः) The son of BHĪMA by the Rākṣasī, named HIḌIMBĀ.
घटोत्कचान्तक: घटोत्कचान्तक m. (-कः) A name of KARṆA, natural brother to the Pāṇḍus. E. घटोत्कच a proper name, and अन्तक destroyer.
घटोद्भव: घटोद्भव m. (-वः) The sage AGASTYA. E. घट a jar, and उद्भव born, produced.
घट्ट: घट्ट r. 1st and 10th cls. (घट्टते घट्टयति) To move. With परि prefixed, To spread or diffuse. With वि, To rub gently, to scratch.

घट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A Ghat, a quay or landing place, steps on the side of a river, &c. leading to the water's edge. f. (-ट्टी) A small or inferior landing place, private stairs, &c. E. घट्ट to go, affix अच्, and with ङीष् affix, implying diminution.
घट्टना: घट्टना f. (-ना) 1 Going, moving. 2 Practice, business, means of living. 3 Rubbing or striking together. E. घट्ट to go, affix युच्, fem. टाप्.
घट्टजीविन्: घट्टजीविन् m. (-वी) An attendant at a landing place, who takes care of the clothes of the bathers, &c. E. घट्ट, and जीविन् who subsists.
घण: घण (उ,) घणु r. 8th cl. (घणुति or घणुते) To shine.
घण्ट: घण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A sort of sauce, vegetables made into a pulp with water, turmeric, mustard seeds and capsicums. f. (-ण्टा) 1 A bell; also a plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a bell. 2 A plant: see घण्टापाटली. E. हन to strike, ट affix, fem. टाप्, and deriv. irr.
घण्टाक: घण्टाक m. (-कः) A plant: see घण्टापाटली. E. कन् added to the preceding; some copies read घण्टीक and घाण्टीक.
घण्टाकर्ण: घण्टाकर्ण m. (-र्णः) One of ŚIVA'S attendants, who is supposed to preside over cutaneous complaints, and is worshipped for exemption from them in the month Chaitra. E. घण्टा, and कर्ण an ear; having ears as broad as a bell.
घण्टाताड: घण्टाताड m. (-डः) A bellman, one who strikes a bell or Gharī. E. घण्टा, and ताड who beats.
घण्टाताडन: घण्टाताडन n. (-नं) Striking a bell. E. घण्टा, and ताडन beating.
घण्टानाद: घण्टानाद m. (-दः) The sound of a bell, &c. E. घण्टा, and माद sound.
घण्टापथ: घण्टापथ m. (-थः) The chief road through a village, a highway. E. घण्टा a bell, and पथि a road, affix अ; the bell-road, or that by which elephants, &c. decorated with tinkling ornaments, proceed.
घण्टापाटली: घण्टापाटली f. (-ली) A plant commonly called by the similar name Ghaṇṭāpārali, a species of the trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. घण्टा a bell, &c. and पाटली the trumpet flower.
घण्टावाद्य: घण्टावाद्य n. (-द्यं) The sound of a clock. E. घण्ठा, and वाद्य playing.
घण्टावीज: घण्टावीज n. (-जं) The croton nut. E. घण्टा, and वीज seed.
घण्टारवा: घण्टारवा f. (-वा) Crotolaria of various species. E. घण्टा, and रव sound; the seed rattling within the husk.
घण्टाशब्द: घण्टाशब्द m. (-ब्दं) 1 Bellmetal. 2 The sound of a bell. E. घण्टा, and शब्द sound.
घण्टास्वन: घण्टास्वन m. (-नः) The sound of a bell or clock. E. घण्टा, and स्वन sound.
घण्टिका: घण्टिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. घण्ठा a bell, and कन् affix of similitude.
घण्टु: घण्टु m. (-ण्टुः) 1 A string of bells tied on an elephant's chest, &c. by way of ornament. 2 Heat, light, &c. घण to shine, Uṇādi affix टु.
घण्टेश्वर: घण्टेश्वर m. (-रः) A minor deity, the son of MARS. E. घण्टा, and ईश्रर lord.
घन: घन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Material, solid. 2 Coarse, gross. 3 Compact. 4 Hard, firm. 5 Full, plump. 6 Impenetrable. 7 Viscid, thick, inspissated. 8 Deep, (as sound.) 9 Very, much. 10 Auspicious, fortunate. 11 A Permanent, eternal. m. (-नः) 1 A cloud. 2 An iron club. 3 The body. 4 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) 5 A number, an assemblage or quantity. 6 Extension, diffusion. 7 Hardness. 8 Solidity, substance, matter. 9 The cube of a number, (in arithmetic.) 10 A solid, (in geometry.) 11 Phlegm. 12 Talc. n. (-नं) 1 A cymbal, a bell, a Gong, &c. any brazen or composite metallic instrument, which is struck as a clock, &c. 2 A mode of dancing, neither quick nor slow. 3 Iron. 4 Skin, rind, bark, &c. E. हन to strike or be struck, affix अप्, and ह changed to घ.
घनकफ: घनकफ m. (-फः) Hail. E. घन a cloud, and कफ phlegm.
घनकाल: घनकाल m. (-लः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, and काल time.
घनगोलक: घनगोलक m. (-कः) An alloy of gold and silver.
घनघनौघ: घनघनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of dark clouds. E. घन thick, close, घनौघ cumulus.
घनचय: घनचय m. (-यः) A collection of clouds, cumulus. E. घन, and चय a heap.
घनजम्बाल: घनजम्बाल m. (-लः) A quantity of mire, a slough. E. घन much, a heap, and जम्बाल mud.
घनजाल: घनजाल n. (-लं) A gathering of clouds. E. घन, and जाल multitude.
घनज्वाला: घनज्वाला f. (-ला) Lightning, a flash of lightning. E. घन a cloud, and ज्वाला flame.
घनताल: घनताल m. (-लः) A bird: see घनतोल.
घनतिमिर: घनतिमिर n. (-रं) 1 The darkness of clouds. 2 Great darkness. E. घन, and तिमिर dark.
घनत्व: घनत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Firmness, compactness. 2 Thickness, coarseness, solidity. E. त्व added to घन; also with तल्, घनता.
घनतोल: घनतोल m. (-लः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. घन a cloud, and तुल to be equal, affix घञ्; who soars to the clouds in the rainy season, which, according to the fable, is the only time when he gets water to drink; some books have घनताल from ताल tune, or sound; whose music is (from) the clouds.
घनध्वनि: घनध्वनि mfn. (-निः-निः-नि) Roaring, who or what makes such a sound. m. (-निः) 1 A deep and loud tone, a roar. 2 The muttering of thunder clouds. E. घन, and ध्वनि sound.
घननाभि: घननाभि m. (-भिः) Smoke. E. घन a cloud, and नाभि the navel or centre; smoke being supposed to be a principal ingredient in clouds.
घननीहार: घननीहार m. (-रः) Thick falling frost or snow. E. घन, and नीहार hoar frost.
घनपदवी: घनपदवी f. (-वी) The sky. E. घन a cloud, and पदवी station.
घनपयोधर: घनपयोधर m. (-रः) A firm breast. E. घन, and पयोधर the female breast.
घनपल्लव: घनपल्लव m. (-बः) A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga:) see शोमाञ्जन. E. घन abundance, and पल्लव a shoot or sprout.
घनपाषण्ड: घनपाषण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A peacock. E. घन a cloud, and पाषण्ड a sectary; this bird is supposed to delight in cloudy and rainy weather.
घनफल: घनफल n. (-लं) The contents of a solid, (in Geometry.) E. घन, and फल fruit.
घनमूल: घनमूल n. (-लं) Cube root, (in Arithmetic.) E. घन, and मूल root.
घनरव: घनरव m. (-वः) The roaring of clouds, thunder. E. घन, and रव sound.
घनरस: घनरस mn. (-सः-सं) Water. m. (-स) 1 Camphor. 2 Extract, decoction, &c. 3 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides.) 4 Thick or inspissated juice. E. घन a cloud or a heap, and रस juice, essence.
घनवर्त्मन्: घनवर्त्मन् n. (-र्त्म) The sky. E. घन, and वर्त्मन् path.
घनवल्लिका: घनवल्लिका f. (-का) Lightning. E. घन a cloud, and वल्लिका a creeper.
घनवल्ली: घनवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Lightning. E. चन, and वल्ली a creeper.
घनवात: घनवात m. (-तः) One of the regions of hell. E. घन much, and वात wind; the region of storm.
घनवास: घनवास m. (-सः) A pumpkin gourd. E. घन a long time, and वास abiding.
घनवाहन: घनवाहन m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of INDRA. E. घन a cloud, and वाहन a vehicle; who rides in the clouds.
घनवीथि: घनवीथि f. (-थिः) A line of clouds. E. घन, and वीथि a row.
घनशब्द: घनशब्द m. (ब्दः) The noise of clouds, thunder. E. घन, and शब्द sound.
घनश्याम: घनश्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Black, deep black, as that of heavy clouds. m. (-मः) 1 RĀMA. 2 KṚṢṆA. E. घन, and श्याम black.
घनसंवृत्ति: घनसंवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Profound secrecy. E. घन impenetrable, संवृत्ति secret purpose.
घनस्वन: घनस्वन m. (-नः) Low thunder, the muttering of clouds. E. घन, and स्वन sound.
घनसमय: घनसमय m. (-यः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, समय time.
घनसार: घनसार m. (-रः) 1 Camphor. 2 Mercury, or some peculiar form of it. 3 Water. 4 A kind of tree. E. घन firm, &c. and सार essence.
घनाकर: घनाकर m. (-रः) The rainy season. E. घन a cloud, and आकर a mine or place of producing.
घनाघन: घनाघन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Mischievous, cruel. 2 Even, uniform, without spaces or interstices. m. (-नः) 1 A name of INDRA. 2 A vicious elephant, or one in rut. 3 A rainy cloud. 4 Mutual collision. f. (-ना) A vegetable, (Solanum Indicum;) also काकमाची. E. घन as above, reiterated and the final of the first made long.
घनात्यय: घनात्यय m. (-यः) The season succeeding the rains, autumn. E. घन a cloud, and अत्यय disappearance, departure.
घनान्त: घनान्त n. (-न्तं) Autumn, the end of the rains. E. घन a cloud, and अन्त end.
घनामय: घनामय m. (-यः) The date tree, (Elate sylvestris.) E. घन a cloud, and आमय sickness, pining in the rains.
घनामल: घनामल m. (-लः) A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium album:) see वास्तूक. E. घन much, and अमल clear, clean.
घनाम्बु: घनाम्बु n. (-म्बु) Rain. E. घन, and अम्बु water.
घनारुण: घनारुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Deep red. E. घन, and अरुण red.
घनारुद्ध: घनारुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds. E. घन, and आरुद्ध obstructed.
घनावरुद्ध: घनावरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Overcast, overspread with clouds. E. घन, and अवरुद्ध impeded.
घनाश्रय: घनाश्रय m. (-यः) Æther, the atmosphere or heaven. E. घन a cloud, and आश्रय asylum.
घनीकृत: घनीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Hardened, compacted, made solid or firm. 2 Congealed, thickened. E. घन, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
घनोदधि: घनोदधि m. (-धिः) A division of hell. E. घन viscid, and उदधि an ocean.
घनोपल: घनोपल m. (-लः) Hail. E. घन a cloud, and उपल a stone.
घनोपरुद्ध: घनोपरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Clouded, overcast. E. घन, and उपरुद्ध obstructed.
घनौघ: घनौघ m. (-घः) A gathering of clouds. E. घन, and ओघ a heap.
घम्ब: घम्ब r. 1st cl. (घम्बयति) To go, to move.
घर्घट: घर्घट m. (-टः) A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora or P. tengara, HAM.) E. घर् an imitative sound, and घट to endeavour, affix अच्; who makes such a sound.
घर्घर: घर्घर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One of the tones or notes in music. m. (-रः) 1 The pass of a mountain. 2 A door, a gate. 3 An owl. 4 The name of a river, the Gogra or Ghogra. 5 Sound. 6 Laughter, mirth. 7 A fire of straw or chaff. f. (-रा or -री) A girdle of small bells or tinkling ornaments worn by women. f. (-रा) A kind of lute. E. घर्घ here said to imply an inarticulate sound, gurgling, &c. and रा to give or take, affix डः also with कन् added घर्घरक.
घर्घरारव: घर्घरारव m. (-वः) A tinkling sound, the sound of small bells. E. घर्घरा, and रव sound.
घर्घरिका: घर्घरिका f. (-का) 1 An ornament of small bells worn by women, horses, &c. 2 The bow or stick of a viol, &c. 3 A sort of musical instrument. 4 Fried grain. 5 The name of a river. E. घर्घरी as above, and कन् added fem. form.
घर्घूघा: घर्घूघा m. (-घा) 1 A sort of insect.
घर्ब: घर्ब r. 1st cl. (घर्बति) To go, to move.
घर्म: घर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Heat. 2 The hot season. 3 Sunshine. 4 Sweat, perspiration. E. घृ to sprinkle, and मक् Uṇādi affix; what sprinkles the limbs.
घर्म्म: घर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) 1 Heat. 2 The hot season. 3 Sunshine. 4 Sweat, perspiration. E. घृ to sprinkle, and मक् Uṇādi affix; what sprinkles the limbs.
घर्मचर्चिका: घर्म्मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Eruptions from suppressed perspiration. E. घम्म, and चर्च्चिका.
घर्म्मचर्च्चिका: घर्म्मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Eruptions from suppressed perspiration. E. घम्म, and चर्च्चिका.
घर्मद्युति: घर्म्मद्युति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. घर्म्म, and द्युति splendor.
घर्म्मद्युति: घर्म्मद्युति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. घर्म्म, and द्युति splendor.
घर्मपयस्: घर्म्मपयस् n. (-यः) 1 Sweat, perspiration. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and पयस् water.
घर्म्मपयस्: घर्म्मपयस् n. (-यः) 1 Sweat, perspiration. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and पयस् water.
घर्मरश्मि: घर्म्मरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) 1 The sun. 2 Heat, radiance. E. घर्म्म, and रश्मि a ray.
घर्म्मरश्मि: घर्म्मरश्मि m. (-श्मिः) 1 The sun. 2 Heat, radiance. E. घर्म्म, and रश्मि a ray.
घर्मविचर्चिका: घर्म्मविचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Cutaneous eruptions or pimples from suppressed perspiration. E. घर्म्म, and विचर्च्चिका pustular eruption.
घर्म्मविचर्च्चिका: घर्म्मविचर्च्चिका f. (-का) Cutaneous eruptions or pimples from suppressed perspiration. E. घर्म्म, and विचर्च्चिका pustular eruption.
घर्मान्त: घर्म्मान्त m. (-न्तः) The rainy season. E. घर्म्म, and अन्त end.
घर्म्मान्त: घर्म्मान्त m. (-न्तः) The rainy season. E. घर्म्म, and अन्त end.
घर्मान्तकामुकी: घर्म्मान्तकामुकी m. (-की) A small white bird; a kind of crane. E. घर्म्मान्त, and कामुकी who wishes for.
घर्म्मान्तकामुकी: घर्म्मान्तकामुकी m. (-की) A small white bird; a kind of crane. E. घर्म्मान्त, and कामुकी who wishes for.
घर्मार्त: घर्म्मार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering from heat. E. घर्म्म, and आर्त्त pained by.
घर्म्मार्त्त: घर्म्मार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Suffering from heat. E. घर्म्म, and आर्त्त pained by.
घर्माम्बु: घर्म्माम्बु n. (-म्बु) 1 Perspiration, sweat. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and अम्वु water.
घर्म्माम्बु: घर्म्माम्बु n. (-म्बु) 1 Perspiration, sweat. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and अम्वु water.
घर्मोदक: घर्म्मोदक n. (-कं) 1 Perspiration. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and उदक water.
घर्म्मोदक: घर्म्मोदक n. (-कं) 1 Perspiration. 2 Warm water. E. घर्म्म, and उदक water.
घर्ष: घर्ष m. (-र्षः) Rubbing, friction. E. घृष to rub, घञ् aff.
घर्षण: घर्षण n. (-णं) 1 Grinding, pounding. 2 Rubbing, friction. f. (-णी) Turmeric. E. घृष to grind, affix ल्युट्.
घर्षणाल: घर्षणाल m. (-लः) A wooden roller or pestle for grinding, &c. E. घर्षण rubbing, and अल what is fit for.
घर्षित: घर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Rubbed. 2 Ground. E. घृष to rub, affix क्त.
घष: घष (इ) घषि r. 1st cl. (घंषते) To render handsome or brilliant.
घस: घस (आ ऌ,) औघसॢ r. 1st cl. (घसति) To eat: this root is in many tenses a substitute for अद, and is itself imperfect in others. (इ,) घसि r. 1st cl. (घंसते) To sprinkle or drop; this root is not generally admitted.
घसि: घसि m. (-सिः) Food, victuals. E. घस to eat, इन् aff.
घस्मर: घस्मर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Gluttonous, voracious. E. घस to eat, क्भरच् aff.
घस्र: घस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं) Mischievous, hurtful. m. (-स्रः) A day. n. (-स्रं) Saffron. E. घस to eat, and रक् aff.
घाट: घाट mf. (-टः-टी) The nape or back of the neck. E. घट to unite, affix अच्; the radical is of the 10th class of roots, whence the penultimate is long.
घाटिका: घाटिका f. (-का) The nape of the neck. E. कन् added to the preceding.
घाण्टिक: घाण्टिक m. (-कः) 1 A bard, who sings in chorus, but especially in honour of the gods, and rings a bell in presence of their images. 2 Datura fastuosa. E. घण्टा a bell, affix ठक्.
घात: घात n. (-तं) 1 Striking, wounding, killing. 2 A bruise, a blow. 3 An arrow. 4 Product (of a sum in multiplication.) E. हन to kill, घञ् affix, and the radical letters changed respectively to घ and त.
घातक: घातक m. (-कः) A murderer, a maimer, &c. E. हन as above, with ण्वुल् aff.
घातन: घातन m. (-नः) A murderer, a killer. n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Striking. 3 Immolating victims. E. हन to kill, युन् affix, and घात substituted for the radical.
घातयत्: घातयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Striking, hurting, killing. E. हन to kill, causal form, शतृ aff.
घातव्य: घातव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be killed, what may be or ought to be killed, &c. E. हन to kill, तव्य affix, and घा substituted.
घातस्थान: घातस्थान n. (-नं) 1 A slaughter house. 2 A place of execution. E. घात, and स्थान place.
घाति: घाति m. (-तिः) 1 Catching or killing birds, fowling. 2 Killing in general. 3 Striking. E. हन to kill or hurt, affix इञ्, and the radical changed: see घात.
घातिन्: घातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Murderous, felonious, who or what strikes or kills. E. हन to kill, णिनि aff.
घातिपक्षिन्: घातिपक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A hawk or falcon. E. घाति fowling, and पक्षिन् a bird.
घातुक: घातुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Mischievous, hurtful. 2 Cruel, savage, violent, ferocious. E. हन to kill, changed to घत, and उकञ् aff.
घात्य: घात्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Proper or fit to be killed. E. हन, and ण्यत् aff.
घार: घार m. (-रः) Sprinkling, wetting. E. घृ to sprinkle, and घञ् aff.
घार्तिक: घार्त्तिक m. (-कः) Pulse ground and fried with clarified butter. E. घृत ghee, and ठक् aff.
घार्त्तिक: घार्त्तिक m. (-कः) Pulse ground and fried with clarified butter. E. घृत ghee, and ठक् aff.
घास: घास m. (-सः) Meadow or pasture grass. E. घस to eat, घञ् affix; what is eaten by animals.
घासि: घासि m. (-सिः) Fire or its deity. E. घस to devour, and इन Uṇādi aff.
घिण: घिण r. 1st cl. (इ) घिणि (घिण्णते) To take, to seize or accept.
घु: घु m. (-घुः) Sound. E. घु to sound, aff. क्विप्.
घुट: घुट r. 1st cl. (घोटते) 1 To come back, to return. 2 To barter or exchange. r. 6th cl. (घुटति) 1 To strike again or retaliate, to resist or oppose. 2 To prevent. 3 To protect or preserve.
घुट m. (-टः) The ancle. E. घुट to resist, and क affix; also घुटि, &c.
घुटि: घुटि f. (-टिः-टी) The ancle. E. घुट to resist, affix कि, and ङीप् may be added; also with कन् added घुटिका.
घुटिक: घुटिक mf. (-कः-का) The ancle, &c. see घुट and घुटि; also घुण्ट.
घुण: घुण r. 1st and 6th cls. (घोणति घुणति) To roll, to whirl, to turn round, (इ) घुणि r. 1st cl. (घुणते) To take or accept.
घुण m. (-णः) 1 An insect that is found in timber. 2 The pangolin or armadillo. E. घुण to turn round, affix क.
घुण्ट: घुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) The ancle. E. घुट to resist, affix क and नुम् inserted; also with कन् added घुण्टक, or without the augment घुट &c. as above.
घुण्टिक: घुण्टिक n. (-कं) Cowdung found in thickets.
घुण्ड: घुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A large black bee. E. घुण to roll, Uṇādi affix ड.
घुर: घुर r. 6th cl. (घुरति) 1 To be frightful or terrible. 2 To sound.
घुर (ई) घुरी r. 4th cl. (घुर्य्यते) 1 To be ignorant. 2 To inquire.
घुर्घुर: घुर्घुर m. (-रः) A kind of worm burrowing in the skin, guinea worm, Dracunculus. f. (-री) The mole cricket. f. (-रा) Growling, as of dog or cat. E. घुर् imitative sound, and घुर to sound, with क aff.
घुष: घुष (इ) घुषि r. 1st cl. (घुषते) To render beautiful or brilliant. (इर) घुषिर r. 1st cl. (घोषति) To do any act except manifest sentiment by sound. r. 10th cl. (घोषयति) 1 To manifest sentiment or thought by sound, to speak, to affirm, to declare or proclaim. 2 To make various sounds. 3 To praise. With आङ् prefixed, To weep incessantly.
घुषित: घुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested by sound, proclaimed. E. घुष as above, affix क्त, इट् augment; also घुष्ट.
घुष्ट: घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded, proclaimed. E. घुष to sound, क्त aff.
घुष्टन्न: घुष्टन्न n. (-न्नं) Food given away by proclamation. E. घुष्ठ, and अङ्ग food.
घुष्ट्र: घुष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A car, a carriage.
घुसृण: घुसृण n. (-णं) Saffron. E. घुषि to beautify, ऋणच्त aff.
घूक: घूक m. (-कः) An owl. E. घू an imitative sound, and क who sounds, from कै with ड aff.
घूकारि: घूकारि m. (-रिः) A crow. E. घूक an owl, and अरि an enemy.
घूर: घूर (इ) घूरी r. 4th cl. (घूर्य्यते) 1 To kill, to hurt or injure. 2 To become old, to decay.
घूर्ण: घूर्ण r. 1st and 6th cls. (घूर्णते, घूर्णति) To roll, to whirl, to turn round.
घूर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides:) see ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक. 2 Turning round, whirling, rolling, &c. E. घूर्ण to roll, affix अच्.
घूर्णन: घूर्णन n. (-र्नं) Revolving, whirling, turning round. E. घूर्ण to whirl, ल्युट् aff.
घूर्णायमान: घूर्णायमान m. (-नः-ना-नं) Whirling, revolving, rolling, tossing. E. घूर्ण, and शानच् aff.
घूर्णि: घूर्णि f. (-र्णिः) Rolling, revolving, going round or over. E. घूर्ण, and इन् aff.
घूर्णित: घूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling, turning, tossing. E. घूर्ण to turn round, affix क्त.
घूर्ण्यमान: घूर्ण्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Agitated, set in motion, made to go round. E. घूर्ण to revolve, pass. voice, शानच् affix; also घूर्णमान middle voice.
घृ: घृ r. 1st, 3d and 10th cls. (घरति जिघर्त्ति and घरयति) 1 To sprinkle, to wet or moisten. 2 To drop or distil. 3 To shine.
घृण: घृण (उ,) घृणु 8th cl. (घर्णोति घणुते) To shine. (इ) घृणि r. 1st cl. (घृणते) To take or accept.
घृणा: घृणा (-णा) 1 Reproach, blame, censure, &c. 2 Compassion, tenderness, pity. E. घृण to shine, अङ् and टाप् affixes, or घृ to sprinkle, with णक् and टाप् affs.
घृणि: घृणि m. (-णिः) 1 A ray of the sun or moon. 2 The sun. 3 Water. E. घृण to shine, affix इन्; or घृ to sprinkle, Uṇādi नि.
घृणित: घृणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Abused, hated. 2 Pitied. E. घृणा pity, इतच् aff.
घृणिन्: घृणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 1 Censorious, abusive. 2 Compassionate. E. घृणा, and इनि aff.
घृत: घृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sprinkled. 2 Illumined. n. (-तं) 1 Ghee, clarified butter, or butter which has been boiled gently, and allowed to cool: it is then used for culinary and religious purposes, and is highly esteemed by the Hindus. 2 Water. f. (-ता) The name of a tree: see घृतमण्डा. E. घृ to sprinkle, Uṇādi affix क्त.
घृतकुमारी: घृतकुमारी f. (-री) The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.) E. घृत ghee, to which the extract is compared, and कुमारी a virgin, which the plant is supposed to resemble in delicacy and elegance; also घृतकुमारिका.
घृतकुम्भ: घृतकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A jar of ghee. E. घृत, and कुम्भ a jar.
घृतदीधिति: घृतदीधिति m. (-तिः) The deity of fire. E. घृत ghee, and दीधिति light; offerings to fire, always comprehending clarified butter.
घृतपशु: घृतपशु m. (-शुः) Ghee made into or supposed to resemble an animal to be offered at a sacrifice or eaten at a meal, for which it is substituted. E. घृत, and पशु an animal.
घृतपूर: घृतपूर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat composed of flour, milk, cocoanut and ghee, &c. E. घृत ghee, and पूर what is full of.
घृतपूर्णक: घृतपूर्णक m. (-कः) A tree, (Galedupa arborea, &c.:) see करञ्ज. E. घृत ghee, and पूर्ण full, कन् added.
घृतप्राश: घृतप्राश m. (-शः) Swallowing ghee. E. घृत, and प्राश eating.
घृतप्राशन: घृतप्राशन n. (-नं) Tasting or swallowing ghee. E. घृत, and प्राशन eating.
घृतप्लुत: घृतप्लुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sprinkled or smeared with ghee. E. घृत and प्लुत bathed.
घृतमण्डा: घृतमण्डा f. (-ण्डा) A tree; also वायसोली. E. घृत, and मण्ड scum; the scum of its infusion resembling ghee.
घृतलोलीकृत: घृतलोलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mixed with ghee, steeped in it or wet with it, &c. E. घृत, लोल desirous, कृत made, च्चि augment.
घृतवर: घृतवर m. (-रः) A sweetmeat, or flour, &c. baked with ghee and sugar. E. घृत, and वर what excels.
घृतविक्रयिन्: घृतविक्रयिन् m. (-यी) A vender of ghee. E. घृत, विक्रय to sell, इनि aff.
घृतस्पृश्: घृतस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Who or what touches ghee. E. घृत, स्पृश to touch, क्विन् aff.
घृताक्त: घृताक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared with ghee. E. घृत, and अक्त smeared.
घृताची: घृताची f. (-ची) One of the Apsaras or courtezans of Svarga. E. घृत ghee, अञ्च to worship, क्विप् and ङीप् affs.
घृताचीगर्भसम्भवा: घृताचीगर्भ्भसम्भवा f. (-वा) Large cardamoms. E. घृताची, गर्म्भ the womb, and सम्भव born from.
घृताचीगर्भ्भसम्भवा: घृताचीगर्भ्भसम्भवा f. (-वा) Large cardamoms. E. घृताची, गर्म्भ the womb, and सम्भव born from.
घृताभ्यक्त: घृताभ्यक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Smeared or anointed with ghee. E. घृत, and अभ्यक्त anointed.
घृताह्व: घृताह्व m. (-ह्वः) Turpentine. E. घृत ghee, and आहूआ an appellation, named from ghee.
घृतेली: घृतेली f. (-ली) A cockroach. E. घृत ghee, इर to go, घञ् affix, र changed to ल, fem. affix ङीप्.
घृतोद: घृतोद m. (-दः) The sea of ghee surrounding Kusa Dvīpa. E. घृत, and उद water.
घृतोदङ्क: घृतोदङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A leather vessel holding ghee. E. घृत, उद up, अञ्च to go, affix घञ्.
घृष: घृष (उ) घृषु r. 1st cl. (घर्षति) To grind or pound.
घृष्ट: घृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Ground, rubbed, pounded. 2 Frayed, grazed, rubbed off. E. घृष to rub, क्त aff.
घृष्टि: घृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A hog; also गृष्टि. f. (-ष्टिः) 1 A plant, commonly Varāhakrāntī, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 2 Grinding, pounding. 3 Emulation, contest. E. घृष to grind, affix क्तिन्.
घृष्टिला: घृष्टिला f. (-ला) A plant: see पृश्निपर्णी.
घृष्वि: घृष्वि m. (-ष्विः) A hog. E. घृष to rub, Uṇādi affix क्विन्.
घेञ्चुलिका: घेञ्चुलिका f. (-का) An esculent root, (Arum orinense.)
घोट: घोट m. (-टः) A horse: see the next.
घोटक: घोटक m. (-कः) A horse. f. (-टिका) A mare. E. घुट to strike again, (to spurn the ground,) अच् and कन् affixes, or without the latter affix घोट.
घोणा: घोणा f. (-णा) 1 The nose. 2 The nose or nostrils of a horse. E. घुण to roll, to turn, and अच् and टाप् aff.
घोणिन्: घोणिन् m. (-णी) A hog. E. घोणा nose or snout, and इनि aff.
घोण्टा: घोण्टा f. (-ण्टा) 1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) 2 The betel-nut tree: see गुवाक. 3 A timber tree, (Schrebera swietenioides.) E. घुट to resist, affix अच्, and नुम् inserted.
घोनस: घोनस m. (-सः) A large kind of snake. E. घा for गो a cow, and नस a nose, see गोनस; according to others the word is घोणस, from घुण to roll, and असच् aff.
घोर: घोर r. 1st cl. (घोरति) To go as a horse.

घोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Frightful, horrible, terrific. m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA. f. (-रा) Night. n. (-रं) Horror, horribleness. 2 Poison. E. घुर to be frightful, affix अच्; or घुर substituted for हन to injure or kill, and अच् Uṇādi aff.
घोरदर्शन: घोरदर्शन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Terrific, of horrid or frightful appearance. m. (-नः) An owl. E. घोर as above, and दर्शन sight.
घोरपुष्प: घोरपुष्प n. (-ष्पः) Bellmetal. E. घोर, and पुष्प a flower.
घोररासन: घोररासन m. (-नः) A jackall. E. घोर frightful, and रासन cry or sound, from रास to sound, affix ल्युट्.
घोररासिन्: घोररासिन् m. (-सी) A jackall. E. see the last, णिनि aff.
घोररूप: घोररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Frightful, hideous. n. (-पं) A hideous appearance. E. घोर, and रूप form.
घोररूपिन्: घोररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Frightful, horrible, hideous. E. घोररूप, and इनि aff.
घोरसङ्काश: घोरसङ्काश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Dreadful, horrible. E. घोर, and सङ्काश like.
घोराकृति: घोराकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Frightful, hideous, of horrible aspect or form. E. घोर, and आकृति form.
घोल: घोल n. (-लं) Buttermilk. E. घुर substituted for हन to strike, (i. e. with the churn,) and अच् affix, र changed to ल.
घोष: घोष m. (-षः) 1 A station of herdsman. 2 A herdsman. 3 A creeping plant, commonly called by the same name Ghoṣa, and bearing white or yellow flowers, (Luffa pentandra and acutangula.) 4 Bellmetal, tutenague, &c. 5 Low thunder or the muttering of clouds. 6 Sound. 7 A proclamation. 8 A gnat, a musquito. 9 A term proper for the name of a Kāyastha. f. (-षा) A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa:) see मघुरिका. E. घुसि to shine, to sound, &c. affix घञ्.
घोषक: घोषक m. (-कः) 1 A cryer, a proclaimer. 2 Ghoṣa, described as a creeping plant, (Luffa pentangula, &c.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
घोषकाकृति: घोषकाकृति f. (-तिः) A plant commonly called Hātīghoṣa, and perhaps a species of the preceding. E. घोषक Ghoṣa, and आकृति shape, appearance, of similar appearance.
घोषण: घोषण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Speaking loud, making a great noise. 2 Crying, proclaiming. E. घुष to sound, affixes युच् and टाप्.
घोषयित्नु: घोषयित्नु m. (-त्नु) 1 A Brahman. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 3 A captive. 4 A cryer, a herald. E. घोष sound, &c. इत्नुच् affix, and य inserted.
घोषवती: घोषवती f. (-तीः) A lute, a Vīṇā. E. घोष sound, and मतुप् poss. aff.
घौर: घौर n. (-रं) Horror, horribleness. E. घोर, and अण् aff.
घ्नत्: घ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नन्ती-घ्नत्) Striking, beating, hurting, killing. E. हन to strike, &c. शतृ aff.
घ्रति: घ्रति f. (-तिः) The nose. E. घ्रा to smell, डति aff.
घ्रा: घ्रा r. 1st cl. (जिघ्रति) To smell, to receive smell.
घ्राण: घ्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Smelled. n. (-णं) 1 The nose. 2 Smell, odour, 3 Smelling. E. घ्रा to smell, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
घ्राणतर्पण: घ्राणतर्पण m. (-णः) Fragrance, odour, a fragrance, a perfume. E. घ्राण the smell, and तर्पण what satisfies.
घ्राणदुःखदा: घ्राणदुःखदा f. (-दा) Sneezing. E. घ्राण, and दुःखदा paining.
घ्रात: घ्रात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled. E. घ्रा to smell, affix क्त.
घ्रात्वा: घ्रात्वा ind. Having smelled. E. घ्रा to smell, क्त्वाच् aff.
घ्राति: घ्राति f. (-तिः) 1 The nose. 2 Smelling. E. घ्रा, and क्तिन् aff. ङ
